name: PEACEKEEPERS [AIRSTRIKES💣]
desc:
🪖"PEACEKEEPERS" is an intense first-person shooter that puts you in the boots of an operative deployed to volatile regions around the world.

Engage in high-stakes tactical operations, clearing out enemy forces and rescuing hostages to secure victory, construct vital infrastructure, aid centers, and support systems to help stabilize local communities, or take on various tasks and missions to earn money, experience, and resources to strengthen your operations.

📢 To keep up with games updates or announcements, community interactions like events, codes and more. Join our community server with the social links below! (13+)

PLUS USERS GET 1.5x EXPERIENCE

All names, logos, symbols, and references used within the game are fictional or used solely for the purpose of artistic storytelling and gameplay immersion.
